name: TabNav
description:
The same strip as `Tabs.List` for tabs that are places (R6.2: routes by default). Renders
links in a `<nav>`: the active one carries `aria-current="page"`, one link is tabbable,
and the arrow keys, Home / End and Space work exactly as in `Tabs`. Overflow moves into the
same "More" menu, whose rows are links too. Router-agnostic: `RouteTabs` adapts it to
TanStack Router.
signature: <T extends TabItem>({ items, value, renderLink, className, ...rest }: TabNavProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders a tab or More-menu row as a link, spreading the props given.

props.name: value
props.description: The active tab's value — derived from the location by the route adapter.
